title: Acceptance during circuit gate parsing
statement: For every Boolean string $\ell$ and Boolean value list $v$, the evaluator started in its gate-parsing phase with values $v$ accepts on $\ell$ exactly when there are a list $G$ of gates and a natural number $o$ such that $\ell$ is the encoding of $G$ followed by the encoding of $o$, every gate in $G$ has at most two distinct arguments, each NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every argument of each gate is below the number of values available when that gate is evaluated. In addition, $o<|v|+|G|$, and the value at index $o$ after evaluating the gates of $G$ successively from the initial values $v$ is true.
